method.geometry: transform each metadata EX_GeographicBoundingBox polygon and pinned feature components from WGS84 to EPSG:6933; count direct intersections and intersections with a 1,000 m buffer
method.interpretation: Catalog-bbox proximity only. An XML bbox is a rectangular catalog footprint and does not establish raster mask coverage, valid source pixels, island occurrence, coast accuracy, completeness, datum, or legal boundary. Absence of a nearby listed tile is only a candidate-source catalog gap.
